title: Flowing Faster to Coordinate: One-Step Online Multi-Agent Flow Policies
title_zh: 更快流动以协调：一步在线多智能体流策略

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a powerful framework for learning coordinated behaviors through interactions with the environment. Developing MARL policies requires balancing expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions with efficient training and execution. Generative policies, particularly diffusion-based policies, can faithfully capture complex and multimodal behaviors, but costly iterative sampling hinders their scalability in online multi-agent settings. We propose an O nline MA RL framework via one-step F low model ( OMAF ) that combines expressive generative policies with efficient one-step action generation. OMAF employs a Transformer-based flow policy to capture complex coordination behaviors, while its approximate path score surrogate provides a principled route to synchronized flow policy optimization. To enable stable and sample-efficient learning, we further develop a joint optimization scheme coupling softmax Q-value estimation with a joint flow policy objective for coordinated policy learning. By eliminating iterative sampling, OMAF dramatically reduces training overhead without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across 10 standard tasks from MPE and MAMuJoCo show that OMAF consistently achieves superior performance, with up to 3.4 × 3.4\times higher returns and 10.5 × 10.5\times sample efficiency improvement compared with baseline methods. These results validate the effectiveness of OMAF as an expressive and computationally efficient one-step flow policy paradigm for online MARL.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）为通过与环境交互来学习协同行为提供了一个强大的框架。 开发 MARL 策略需要在对复杂且多模态的动作分布进行富有表现力的建模与高效的训练和执行之间取得平衡。 生成式策略，尤其是基于扩散的策略，能够忠实地捕捉复杂且多模态的行为，但高成本的迭代采样阻碍了其在在线多智能体场景中的可扩展性。 我们提出了一种通过单步流模型实现的在线多智能体强化学习框架（OMAF），它将富有表现力的生成式策略与高效的单步动作生成相结合。 OMAF 采用基于 Transformer 的流策略来捕捉复杂的协同行为，而其对路径得分的近似代理则为同步优化流策略提供了理论依据。 为了实现稳定且样本高效的學習，我们进一步开发了一种联合优化方案，将 softmax Q 值估计与联合流策略目标耦合，以支持协同策略学习。 通过消除迭代采样，OMAF 在保持策略表现力的同时大幅降低了训练开销。 在 MPE 和 MAMuJoCo 的 10 个标准任务上进行的广泛实验表明，OMAF 始终能取得更优的性能，其回报比基线方法高出最多 3.4 × 3.4\times，样本效率也提升了 10.5 × 10.5\times。 这些结果验证了 OMAF 作为一种富有表现力且计算高效的单步流策略范式，在在线 MARL 中的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) ( Oliehoek et al., 2008 ) harnesses the power of collective intelligence, empowering agents to unlock capabilities beyond those of isolated learners. This collaborative paradigm has driven remarkable advances across diverse domains, from superhuman gameplay ( Vinyals et al., 2019 ; Berner et al., 2019 ; Ye et al., 2020 ) to embodied coordination ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Guo et al., 2026 ) , scientific discovery, e.g., mathematical theorem proving ( Su et al., 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026 ) , and LLM-based agentic systems ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Yang and Thomason, 2026 ) . Realizing such collective capabilities requires policies that are both sample-efficient and expressive enough to capture diverse coordination behaviors ( Lin and Lee, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026d ) .
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）（Oliehoek 等人，2008）利用了集体智慧的力量，使智能体能够解锁超越孤立学习者的能力。 这种协作范式推动了多个领域的显著进步，从超人类的游戏表现（Vinyals 等人，2019；Berner 等人，2019；Ye 等人，2020）到具身协调（Chen 等人，2025a；Guo 等人，2026），再到科学发现，例如数学定理证明（Su 等人，2025；OpenAI，2026）以及基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统（Zhao 等人，2026；Yang 和 Thomason，2026）。 要实现这种集体能力，需要策略既具备样本效率，又具有足够的表达能力以捕捉多样化的协作行为（Lin 和 Lee，2026；Li 等人，2026d）。

sents.en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) ( Oliehoek et al., 2008 ) harnesses the power of collective intelligence, empowering agents to unlock capabilities beyond those of isolated learners.

sents.en: Realizing such collective capabilities requires policies that are both sample-efficient and expressive enough to capture diverse coordination behaviors ( Lin and Lee, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026d ) .
sents.zh: 要实现这种集体能力，需要策略既具备样本效率，又具有足够的表达能力以捕捉多样化的协作行为（Lin 和 Lee，2026；Li 等人，2026d）。

paragraphs.en: Generative policies, particularly diffusion- and flow-based policies ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Lipman et al., 2023 ) , provide a powerful foundation for expressive decision-making, naturally capturing complex and multimodal action distributions and diverse, coordinated behaviors beyond conventional unimodal policies ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Such advantage has translated into strong performance with diffusion policies ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Celik et al., 2025 ) in single-agent online RL, but their iterative sampling remain computationally costly. One-step flow policies overcome this bottleneck with single-step action generation while retaining the benefits of generative modeling ( Zhan et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 生成式策略，特别是基于扩散和流的策略（Ho 等，2020；Lipman 等，2023），为富有表现力的决策提供了强大的基础，能够自然地捕捉复杂的多模态动作分布以及超越传统单模态策略的多样化、协调性行为（Wang 等，2023；Zhang 等，2026b）。 这种优势已转化为扩散策略在单智能体在线强化学习中的出色表现（Ma 等，2025；Celik 等，2025），但其迭代采样过程在计算上仍然成本高昂。 一步流策略通过单步动作生成克服了这一瓶颈，同时保留了生成式建模的优势（Zhan 等，2026；Dong 等，2026）。

sents.en: Generative policies, particularly diffusion- and flow-based policies ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Lipman et al., 2023 ) , provide a powerful foundation for expressive decision-making, naturally capturing complex and multimodal action distributions and diverse, coordinated behaviors beyond conventional unimodal policies ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .

sents.en: Such advantage has translated into strong performance with diffusion policies ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Celik et al., 2025 ) in single-agent online RL, but their iterative sampling remain computationally costly.

sents.en: One-step flow policies overcome this bottleneck with single-step action generation while retaining the benefits of generative modeling ( Zhan et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 一步流策略通过单步动作生成克服了这一瓶颈，同时保留了生成式建模的优势（Zhan 等，2026；Dong 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Yet, efficient generative policies remain underexplored in multi-agent RL, despite being particularly important in this setting. The exponentially larger joint state-action spaces of multiple interacting agents demand expressive policies while amplifying the cost of iterative generation as the number of agents grows ( Lee et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026d ) . Meanwhile, limited interaction data and complex coordination further require high sample efficiency. More critically, few-step flow generation faces a trade-off between efficiency and policy expressiveness, making it challenging in multi-agent settings. Developing expressive generative policies that retain strong coordination performance with efficient one-step generation therefore remains an open challenge for online MARL.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，尽管高效的生成策略在多智能体强化学习中尤为重要，但这一领域仍未被充分探索。 多个相互作用的智能体所构成的联合状态-动作空间呈指数级增长，这不仅要求策略具备高度表达能力，也随着智能体数量的增加而放大了迭代生成的成本（Lee et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026d）。 同时，有限的交互数据和复杂的协调需求进一步要求策略具备较高的样本效率。 更为关键的是，少步流程生成在效率与策略表达能力之间存在权衡，这使得其在多智能体环境中极具挑战性。 因此，开发既能保持强大协调能力、又能通过高效单步生成的表达力强的生成策略，仍然是在线多智能体强化学习领域一个亟待解决的挑战。

sents.en: Yet, efficient generative policies remain underexplored in multi-agent RL, despite being particularly important in this setting.

paragraphs.en: To tackle these challenges, we propose O nline MA RL via one-step F low model ( OMAF ), a framework specifically designed for efficient and expressive policy learning in online MARL. OMAF introduces a Transformer-based one-step flow policy for efficient generative policy learning, retaining the expressive coordination while eliminating iterative denoising. We further develop an approximate path score surrogate and synchronized policy optimization with a joint softmax Q-value ( Pan et al., 2020 ) for stable and sample-efficient training from scratch. Together, these designs jointly address the efficiency–performance challenge of generative policy learning in online MARL. As illustrated in Figure 1 , OMAF simultaneously achieves state-of-the-art performance and training efficiency across multi-agent environments. Our contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了基于单步流模型的在线多智能体强化学习（OMAF）框架，该框架专为在线多智能体强化学习中高效且富有表现力的策略学习而设计。 OMAF 引入了一种基于 Transformer 的单步流策略，以实现高效的生成式策略学习，在保留高度协调能力的同时，消除了迭代去噪过程。 我们进一步开发了一种近似路径得分代理模型，并结合联合 softmax Q 值（Pan et al., 2020）进行同步策略优化，从而实现从头开始的稳定且样本高效的训练。 这些设计共同解决了在线多智能体强化学习中生成式策略学习所面临的效率与性能之间的挑战。 如图 1 所示，OMAF 在多智能体环境中同时实现了当前最先进的性能水平和训练效率。 我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose OMAF , an efficient one-step flow policy for online MARL under the centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE) framework. The policy incorporates a Transformer-based velocity network to generate continuous actions through a single denoising step, retaining expressive multi-agent coordination without iterative sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 OMAF，这是一种高效的单步流策略，适用于集中式训练与去中心化执行（CTDE）框架下的在线多智能体强化学习（MARL）。 该策略整合了一个基于 Transformer 的速度网络，通过单次去噪步骤生成连续动作，在无需迭代采样的情况下保留了具有表现力的多智能体协同能力。

sents.en: We propose OMAF , an efficient one-step flow policy for online MARL under the centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE) framework.

sents.en: The policy incorporates a Transformer-based velocity network to generate continuous actions through a single denoising step, retaining expressive multi-agent coordination without iterative sampling.
sents.zh: 该策略整合了一个基于 Transformer 的速度网络，通过单次去噪步骤生成连续动作，在无需迭代采样的情况下保留了具有表现力的多智能体协同能力。

paragraphs.en: We develop a stable joint optimization scheme to effectively train the one-step flow policy. Softmax Q-value estimation provides smooth and reliable value guidance, while synchronized joint flow policy optimization coordinates policy updates across agents and promotes effective multi-agent coordination. Together, these components facilitate stable and sample-efficient learning of expressive one-step flow policies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种稳定的联合优化方案，以有效训练单步流策略。 Softmax Q值估计提供了平滑且可靠的值指导，而同步的联合流策略优化则协调了各智能体之间的策略更新，并促进了有效的多智能体协作。 这些组件共同促进了具有表现力的单步流策略的稳定且样本高效的学习。

sents.zh: 我们开发了一种稳定的联合优化方案，以有效训练单步流策略。

OMAF consistently achieves the best performance, with up to 3.4 × 3.4\times higher returns and 10.5 × 10.5\times greater sample efficiency than baseline methods, while substantially reducing computational overhead by eliminating iterative denoising.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we discuss representative works on online MARL and flow-based RL policies, and defer a more comprehensive review to Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将讨论在线 MARL 和基于流的 RL 策略的代表性研究，并将更全面的综述留到附录 A 中进行。

paragraphs.en: Online MARL has advanced substantially under centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) ( Oliehoek et al., 2008 ; Matignon et al., 2012 ) , with representative methods such as MADDPG, MAPPO, VDN, QMIX, and QPLEX ( Lowe et al., 2017 ; Yu et al., 2022 ; Sunehag et al., 2018 ; Rashid et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2021 ) improving coordination through centralized critics and value factorization. Recent studies further enhance factorization, exploration, robustness, scalability, and heterogeneous-agent coordination ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Qu et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ) , while decentralized methods address scalability and non-stationarity ( Tampuu et al., 2017 ; de Witt et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Meulemans et al., 2025 ) . Recent works introduce generative policies, including HAQO ( Lin and Lee, 2026 ) , OMAD ( Li et al., 2026d ) and DDPL ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , to improve policy expressiveness and exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 在线 MARL 在集中式训练与去中心化执行（CTDE）（Oliehoek 等人，2008；Matignon 等人，2012）的推动下取得了显著进展，其代表性方法如 MADDPG、MAPPO、VDN、QMIX 和 QPLEX（Lowe 等人，2017；Yu 等人，2022；Sunehag 等人，2018；Rashid 等人，2018；Wang 等人，2021）通过集中式评论器和价值因子分解提升了协同能力。 近期研究进一步增强了因子分解、探索性、鲁棒性、可扩展性和异构智能体协同能力（Huang 等人，2026；Xu 等人，2026；Qu 等人，2026；Pan 等人，2021；Li 等人，2023；Zhong 等人，2024），而去中心化方法则解决了可扩展性和非平稳性问题（Tampuu 等人，2017；de Witt 等人，2020；Li 等人，2026a；Meulemans 等人，2025）。 近期工作引入了生成式策略，包括 HAQO（Lin 和 Lee，2026）、OMAD（Li 等人，2026d）和 DDPL（Zhang 等人，2026c），以提升策略的表达能力和探索性。

paragraphs.en: Flow-based generative policies offer efficient alternatives to diffusion by learning velocity fields that transport noise to actions along straighter trajectories ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Albergo and Vanden-Eijnden, 2023 ; Geng et al., 2025 ) . In RL, existing works study flow models for value estimation, e.g., flowq ( Agrawalla et al., 2026a ; Agrawalla et al., 2026b ) , and expressive policies, including ReinFlow ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , SAC-Flow ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , FlowQ ( Alles et al., 2025 ) , QIPO ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , and FQL ( Park et al., 2025 ) , as well as efficient one-step generation through SSCP ( Koirala and Fleming, 2026 ) , OFQL ( Nguyen and Yoo, 2026 ) , and MVP ( Zhan et al., 2026 ) . Recent methods further optimize flow policies via policy gradients, including FPO ( McAllister et al., 2026 ) , OSMFPG ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , LaMPO ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , FlowRL ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) , RFO ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) , MFPO ( Dong et al., 2026 ) , and FPMD ( Chen et al., 2025b ) . For MARL, MAC-Flow ( Lee et al., 2026a ) and OM 2 P ( Li et al., 2026c ) consider one-step flow policies only in offline learning. We address the missing setting of direct one-step flow optimization in online MARL.
paragraphs.zh: 基于流的生成策略通过学习将噪声沿更直的路径传输到动作的速度场，为扩散模型提供了高效的替代方案（Lipman 等，2023；Liu 等，2023；Albergo 和 Vanden-Eijnden，2023；Geng 等，2025）。 在强化学习中，现有研究探讨了用于价值估计的流模型，例如 flowq（Agrawalla 等，2026a；Agrawalla 等，2026b），以及具有表达能力的策略，包括 ReinFlow（Zhang 等，2025b）、SAC-Flow（Zhang 等，2026b）、FlowQ（Alles 等，2025）、QIPO（Zhang 等，2025a）和 FQL（Park 等，2025），此外还通过 SSCP（Koirala 和 Fleming，2026）、OFQL（Nguyen 和 Yoo，2026）以及 MVP（Zhan 等，2026）实现了高效的一步生成。 近期方法进一步通过策略梯度优化了流策略，包括 FPO（McAllister 等，2026）、OSMFPG（Wang 等，2026）、LaMPO（Liu 等，2026）、FlowRL（Lyu 等，2026）、RFO（Zhong 等，2026）、MFPO（Dong 等，2026）和 FPMD（Chen 等，2025b）。 对于多智能体强化学习（MARL），MAC-Flow（Lee 等，2026a）和 OM 2 P（Li 等，2026c）仅在离线学习中考虑了一步流策略。 我们针对在线 MARL 中直接的一步流优化这一缺失场景提出了解决方案。

paragraphs.en: While flow matching enables efficient generative modeling through continuous transport, applying flow-based policies to online MARL still presents several challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管流匹配通过连续传输实现了高效的生成建模，但将基于流的策略应用于在线多智能体强化学习（MARL）仍然存在若干挑战。

paragraphs.en: First, entropy regularization is hindered by intractable policy likelihoods. In contrast to Gaussian policies, flow-based policies involve densities induced by multi-step generative processes, making likelihood evaluation difficult ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) . This complicates entropy-based exploration in continuous multi-agent action spaces ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 首先，熵正则化受到难以处理的策略似然函数的阻碍。 与高斯策略不同，基于流的策略涉及由多步生成过程诱导的密度，这使得似然评估变得困难（Lipman 等人，2023）。 这给连续多智能体动作空间中的基于熵的探索带来了复杂性（Zhong 等人，2024）。

sents.en: First, entropy regularization is hindered by intractable policy likelihoods.
sents.zh: 首先，熵正则化受到难以处理的策略似然函数的阻碍。

sents.en: In contrast to Gaussian policies, flow-based policies involve densities induced by multi-step generative processes, making likelihood evaluation difficult ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 与高斯策略不同，基于流的策略涉及由多步生成过程诱导的密度，这使得似然评估变得困难（Lipman 等人，2023）。

sents.en: This complicates entropy-based exploration in continuous multi-agent action spaces ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 这给连续多智能体动作空间中的基于熵的探索带来了复杂性（Zhong 等人，2024）。

paragraphs.en: Second, flow policies face a fundamental conflict between joint expressiveness and decentralized execution under CTDE. Joint flows capture inter-agent dependencies but couple agents, while independent flows preserve decentralization at the cost of essential coordination ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 其次，在 CTDE 框架下，流策略面临着联合表达能力与去中心化执行之间的根本性冲突。 联合流能够捕捉智能体间的依赖关系，但会将智能体相互耦合；而独立流虽然保持了去中心化，却以牺牲必要的协调性为代价（Zhu 等人，2024）。

paragraphs.en: Finally, one-step generation exposes an intrinsic mismatch between expressive flow policies and online reward optimization. Aggressive step reduction can degrade action quality due to transport errors ( Li et al., 2026d ) , while RL must reshape the flow toward high-value joint actions ( Pan et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2025b ) . Efficiently reconciling expressive one-step generation with global coordination remains an open challenge in online MARL.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，单步生成暴露了表达性流策略与在线奖励优化之间的内在不匹配。 激进地减少步骤可能会因传输错误而降低动作质量（Li et al., 2026d），而强化学习必须将流重新塑造为高价值联合动作（Pan et al., 2021；Li et al., 2025b）。 高效地协调表达性单步生成与全局协作，仍然是在线多智能体强化学习中的一个开放挑战。

paragraphs.en: These challenges motivate our design of O nline MA RL via one-step F low model ( OMAF ). We next provide theoretical guarantees and insights to characterize the proposed one-step flow policy and its optimization, offering a principled understanding of its expressiveness, value estimation stability, and coordination capability.

paragraphs.en: We provide population-level theoretical guarantees for OMAF under practical approximations. We first establish convergence of flow policy optimization, showing that the learned policy approaches the soft-optimal decentralized policy. paragraphs.en: This section introduces our flow policy algorithm for online multi-agent reinforcement learning, with an overview shown in Figure 2 . To enable efficient one-step flow policy learning in online MARL, OMAF incorporates two key designs: (i) a Transformer-based velocity network that directly parameterizes the flow policy, enabling expressive policy modeling and one-step action generation without iterative sampling or policy distillation; and (ii) a stable joint optimization scheme that combines softmax Q-value estimation with joint policy optimization, providing reliable value guidance while facilitating coordinated policy learning. We detail these components below.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍我们用于在线多智能体强化学习的流策略算法，其概述如图 2 所示。 为了实现在线 MARL 中高效的一步流策略学习，OMAF 融入了两项关键设计：(i) 一种基于 Transformer 的速度网络，该网络直接参数化流策略，从而实现富有表现力的策略建模和一步动作生成，无需迭代采样或策略蒸馏；以及 (ii) 一种稳定的联合优化方案，它将 softmax Q 值估计与联合策略优化相结合，在提供可靠的价值指导的同时促进协调一致的策略学习。 我们将在下文详细说明这些组件。

sents.en: To enable efficient one-step flow policy learning in online MARL, OMAF incorporates two key designs: (i) a Transformer-based velocity network that directly parameterizes the flow policy, enabling expressive policy modeling and one-step action generation without iterative sampling or policy distillation; and (ii) a stable joint optimization scheme that combines softmax Q-value estimation with joint policy optimization, providing reliable value guidance while facilitating coordinated policy learning.
sents.zh: 为了实现在线 MARL 中高效的一步流策略学习，OMAF 融入了两项关键设计：(i) 一种基于 Transformer 的速度网络，该网络直接参数化流策略，从而实现富有表现力的策略建模和一步动作生成，无需迭代采样或策略蒸馏；以及 (ii) 一种稳定的联合优化方案，它将 softmax Q 值估计与联合策略优化相结合，在提供可靠的价值指导的同时促进协调一致的策略学习。

sents.en: We detail these components below.
sents.zh: 我们将在下文详细说明这些组件。

paragraphs.en: OMAF establishes a powerful online flow-based MARL framework that integrates expressive flow policy, efficient one-step generation, and effective multi-agent coordination. While existing MARL methods predominantly use Gaussian policies, e.g., HARL ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) , OMAF adopts a powerful flow policy to capture expressiveness and complicated action distributions. Compared with diffusion-based methods such as OMAD ( Li et al., 2026d ) , OMAF replaces costly diffusion-driven iterative denoising with efficient one-step flow generation, achieving expressive policy modeling without sacrificing generation efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: OMAF 建立了一个强大的基于流的在线 MARL 框架，该框架整合了表现力强的流策略、高效的一步生成以及有效的多智能体协同。 尽管现有的 MARL 方法主要使用高斯策略（例如 HARL (Zhong et al., 2024)），但 OMAF 采用了一种强大的流策略来捕捉表现力和复杂的动作分布。 与基于扩散的方法（如 OMAD (Li et al., 2026d)）相比，OMAF 用高效的一步流生成取代了成本高昂的扩散驱动迭代去噪过程，在实现强大策略建模的同时并未牺牲生成效率。

paragraphs.en: Overall, online MARL faces severe policy instability as the joint state distribution evolves rapidly, making expressive policy modeling and robust value guidance crucial under limited samples. The flow policy provides expressive one-step parameterization, while the path score enables efficient policy optimization and exploration. Building on this foundation, the softmax Q-value objective provides concise and effective guidance against distributional shift, the synchronized policy objective promotes coordinated improvement across agents, and the agent-specific temperature objectives enable fine-grained exploration control. Together, these components form a unified framework for efficient and stable one-step flow policy learning in online MARL.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，在线 MARL 面临着严重的策略不稳定性问题，因为联合状态分布会迅速演变，这使得在样本有限的情况下，构建表达能力强的策略模型和实现稳健的价值引导变得至关重要。 流策略提供了具有表达力的一步参数化方法，而路径分数则实现了高效的策略优化与探索。 在此基础上，softmax Q-值目标函数能够针对分布偏移提供简洁而有效的指导；同步策略目标函数促进了智能体之间的协同改进；而针对每个智能体的温度目标函数则实现了对探索过程的精细控制。 这些组件共同构成了一个统一的框架，用于在线 MARL 中高效且稳定的一步流策略学习。

paragraphs.en: The training procedure of the proposed Online Multi-Agent Flow Policy (OMAF) is summarized in Algorithm 1 . Line 1 initializes the model parameters and replay buffer. Lines 1 - 1 collect trajectories using random policies at the beginning and the learned flow policies thereafter. Once the replay buffer is sufficiently populated, Line 1 updates the centralized critics using K K joint actions sampled from the current flow policies and the softmax Q-value objective, followed by a soft update of the target networks in Line 1 . Every d l d_{l} steps, Line 1 jointly optimizes all flow policies using the centralized Q-function, while Line 1 tunes the agent-wise entropy temperatures.

paragraphs.en: Overall, OMAF establishes a pioneering flow-based approach to online MARL that jointly addresses the expressiveness-efficiency trade-off in generative policy learning. Its one-step flow policy models complex action distributions without the iterative sampling required by diffusion policies, while the path score surrogate enables effective maximum-entropy optimization and captures complex multi-agent coordination. A detailed discussion of the baseline algorithms is provided in Appendix C.4 . We next conduct extensive experiments to evaluate whether these designs translate into improved policy performance and training efficiency across a diverse set of multi-agent tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，OMAF 建立了一种基于流的在线 MARL 开创性方法，该方法共同解决了生成策略学习中的表达力与效率之间的权衡问题。 其单步流策略无需扩散策略所需的迭代采样即可建模复杂的动作分布，同时路径分数代理实现了有效的最大熵优化，并捕捉到了复杂的多智能体协作。 基线算法的详细讨论见附录 C.4。 接下来，我们将进行广泛的实验，以评估这些设计是否能在多样化的多智能体任务中提升策略性能和训练效率。

paragraphs.en: Enviroments. We benchmark OMAF on two widely adopted continuous-control MARL suites: Multi-Agent Particle Environments (MPE) ( Lowe et al., 2017 ) and Multi-Agent MuJoCo (MAMuJoCo) ( Peng et al., 2021 ) . We use Cooperative Navigation in MPE, and HalfCheetah, Ant, Walker, Hopper, and Swimmer in MAMuJoCo, covering particle coordination and high-dimensional locomotion tasks. Detailed environment configurations are provided in Appendix D.1 .

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We consider four representative online MARL baselines for comparison. HATD3 ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) and HASAC ( Liu et al., 2024 ) are two widely used actor-critic methods for online MARL. OMAD ( Li et al., 2026d ) represents the state-of-the-art multi-agent diffusion policy, while MAFlowRL ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) and MAMFPO ( Dong et al., 2026 ) extend flow-based RL methods to the multi-agent setting. All methods are trained with 3 3 random seeds, and we report the mean performance and standard deviation over 10 10 evaluation episodes. Implementation details, including hyperparameters and network architectures, are provided in Appendix D.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 我们考虑了四种具有代表性的在线 MARL 基线方法进行比较。 HATD3（Zhong 等人，2024）和 HASAC（Liu 等人，2024）是两种广泛用于在线 MARL 的演员-评论家方法。 OMAD（Li 等人，2026d）代表了当前最先进的多智能体扩散策略，而 MAFlowRL（Lyu 等人，2026）和 MAMFPO（Dong 等人，2026）则将基于流的方法扩展到了多智能体场景。 所有方法均使用 3 个随机种子进行训练，我们报告了 10 次评估回合的平均性能和标准差。 实现细节（包括超参数和网络架构）见附录 D.2。

paragraphs.en: The overall performance of OMAF is presented in Figure 3 . We evaluate all methods under a limited training budget of fewer than 2 × 10 6 2\times 10^{6} environment interaction steps to assess both performance and sample efficiency. Across all 10 10 MPE and MAMuJoCo tasks, OMAF consistently achieves superior performance compared with the baseline algorithms. This advantage holds for both the MPE tasks with complex coordination and the higher-dimensional MAMuJoCo tasks, demonstrating that OMAF can achieve strong performance with substantially fewer environment interactions. Besides, OMAF achieves up to a 10.5 × 10.5\times improvement in sample efficiency, reaching baseline-level performance with substantially fewer environment interactions.
paragraphs.zh: OMAF 的整体性能展示在图 3 中。 为了评估性能与样本效率，我们在少于 2 × 10⁶ 个环境交互步的有限训练预算下对所有方法进行了评估。 在所有 10 个 MPE 和 MAMuJoCo 任务中，OMA F 始终比基线算法表现出更优的性能。 无论是在需要复杂协作的 MPE 任务中，还是在更高维度的 MAMuJoCo 任务中，这种优势都得以保持，表明 OMAF 能以显著更少的环境交互实现强劲性能。 此外，OMA F 在样本效率上实现了高达 10.5 倍的提升，并以显著更少的环境交互达到了基线水平的性能。

paragraphs.en: Compared with Gaussian-policy methods, including HASAC and HATD3 ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ) , OMAF achieves superior performance, demonstrating the advantage of expressive flow-based policies. In contrast to diffusion-based OMAD ( Li et al., 2026d ) , OMAF achieves better performance without iterative denoising, balancing policy expressiveness and generation efficiency. Against representative multi-agent flow-policy methods, MAFlowRL ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) and MAMFPO ( Dong et al., 2026 ) , OMAF consistently performs better, highlighting the effectiveness of our specific flow-policy design and synchronized value and policy optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 与包括 HASAC 和 HATD3（Liu 等人，2024；Zhong 等人，2024）在内的基于高斯策略的方法相比，OMAF 实现了更优异的性能，展现了表达力强的流基策略的优势。 与基于扩散的 OMAD（Li 等人，2026d）不同，OMAF 无需迭代去噪即可实现更好的性能，在策略表达力与生成效率之间取得了平衡。 在与代表性的多智能体流基策略方法 MAFlowRL（Lyu 等人，2026）和 MAMFPO（Dong 等人，2026）的对比中，OMAF 始终表现更优，凸显了我们特定的流基策略设计以及价值与策略同步优化的有效性。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 4 (details refer to Appendix D ), OMAF achieves superior and well-rounded performance across multiple metrics, outperforming representative baselines algorithms. OMAF consistently performs well across task performance, training and sample efficiency, exploration, and scalability, achieving stronger policies with substantially lower computational resource requirements than diffusion-based OMAD ( Li et al., 2026d ) . Such computational efficiency is crucial for practical and scalable online MARL, where training and inference cost can become a major bottleneck.

paragraphs.en: We present OMAF, an efficient one-step flow policy framework for online multi-agent reinforcement learning. By integrating expressive flow-based policy modeling with synchronized joint policy optimization and softmax Q-value estimation, OMAF enables efficient action generation while effectively capturing multi-agent coordination. Experiments on MPE and MAMuJoCo demonstrate that OMAF achieves superior performance against strong online diffusion-based and flow-based baselines, while requiring only a single flow step for action generation. These results highlight the potential of one-step flow policies as an efficient and expressive approach for online MARL.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 OMAF，这是一种用于在线多智能体强化学习的高效单步流策略框架。 通过将富有表现力的基于流的策略建模与同步联合策略优化及 softmax Q 值估计相结合，OMAF 能够在有效捕捉多智能体协作的同时，实现高效的动作生成。 在 MPE 和 MAMuJoCo 上的实验表明，OMAF 相较于强大的在线扩散基线和流基线方法取得了更优的性能，而动作生成仅需单步流操作。 这些结果凸显了单步流策略作为在线多智能体强化学习（MARL）中一种高效且富有表现力的方法的潜力。

sents.en: We present OMAF, an efficient one-step flow policy framework for online multi-agent reinforcement learning.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 OMAF，这是一种用于在线多智能体强化学习的高效单步流策略框架。

sents.en: By integrating expressive flow-based policy modeling with synchronized joint policy optimization and softmax Q-value estimation, OMAF enables efficient action generation while effectively capturing multi-agent coordination.
sents.zh: 通过将富有表现力的基于流的策略建模与同步联合策略优化及 softmax Q 值估计相结合，OMAF 能够在有效捕捉多智能体协作的同时，实现高效的动作生成。

sents.en: Experiments on MPE and MAMuJoCo demonstrate that OMAF achieves superior performance against strong online diffusion-based and flow-based baselines, while requiring only a single flow step for action generation.
sents.zh: 在 MPE 和 MAMuJoCo 上的实验表明，OMAF 相较于强大的在线扩散基线和流基线方法取得了更优的性能，而动作生成仅需单步流操作。

sents.en: These results highlight the potential of one-step flow policies as an efficient and expressive approach for online MARL.
sents.zh: 这些结果凸显了单步流策略作为在线多智能体强化学习（MARL）中一种高效且富有表现力的方法的潜力。

paragraphs.en: Here, we review related works on online MARL and diffusion- and flow-based policy optimization, covering both single- and multi-agent RL settings. We further discuss the challenges of one-step flow policy optimization in online MARL and compare OMAF with existing approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们回顾了在线 MARL 以及基于扩散和流的策略优化方面的相关研究，涵盖单智能体和多智能体强化学习场景。 我们进一步探讨了在线 MARL 中单步流策略优化的挑战，并将 OMAF 与现有方法进行了比较。

sents.en: Here, we review related works on online MARL and diffusion- and flow-based policy optimization, covering both single- and multi-agent RL settings.
sents.zh: 在此，我们回顾了在线 MARL 以及基于扩散和流的策略优化方面的相关研究，涵盖单智能体和多智能体强化学习场景。

sents.en: We further discuss the challenges of one-step flow policy optimization in online MARL and compare OMAF with existing approaches.
sents.zh: 我们进一步探讨了在线 MARL 中单步流策略优化的挑战，并将 OMAF 与现有方法进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Online multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has achieved substantial progress in recent years. Under the centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) paradigm ( Oliehoek et al., 2008 ; Matignon et al., 2012 ) , a series of influential algorithms, including MADDPG ( Lowe et al., 2017 ) , MAPPO ( Yu et al., 2022 ) , VDN ( Sunehag et al., 2018 ) , COMA ( Foerster et al., 2018 ) , QTRAN ( Son et al., 2019 ) , QMIX ( Rashid et al., 2018 ) , and QPLEX ( Wang et al., 2021 ) , have significantly improved coordination and stability in cooperative tasks. In parallel, fully decentralized approaches such as IQL ( Tampuu et al., 2017 ) , IPPO ( de Witt et al., 2020 ) , and MATD3 ( Ackermann et al., 2019 ) achieve competitive performance without centralized critics, underscoring the scalability of online MARL; recent studies further tackle non-stationarity and co-adaptation in fully decentralized settings via return-aware context modeling ( Li et al., 2026a ) and learning-aware policy gradients ( Meulemans et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，在线多智能体强化学习（MARL）取得了显著进展。 在集中式训练与去中心化执行（CTDE）范式（Oliehoek 等人，2008；Matignon 等人，2012）下，一系列具有影响力的算法，包括 MADDPG（Lowe 等人，2017）、MAPPO（Yu 等人，2022）、VDN（Sunehag 等人，2018）、COMA（Foerster 等人，2018）、QTRAN（Son 等人，2019）、QMIX（Rashid 等人，2018）和 QPLEX（Wang 等人，2021），显著提升了协作任务中的协调性和稳定性。 与此同时，完全去中心化的方法，如 IQL（Tampuu 等人，2017）、IPPO（de Witt 等人，2020）和 MATD3（Ackermann 等人，2019），无需集中式批评者即可实现具有竞争力的性能，凸显了在线 MARL 的可扩展性；近期研究进一步通过回报感知上下文建模（Li 等人，2026a）和学习感知策略梯度（Meulemans 等人，2025），解决了完全去中心化设置中的非平稳性和协同适应问题。

paragraphs.en: Building on these foundations, recent centralized methods further improve online MARL from several perspectives, including value factorization, exploration, robustness, and scalability. Value decomposition and the IGM principle have been enhanced through more expressive factorization ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Qu et al., 2026 ) , while centralized policy optimization and exploration are improved through joint-policy alignment and adaptive context modeling ( Xie et al., 2026 ; Duan et al., 2026 ) . Other works study exploration, robustness, and scalability through regularization, curriculum learning, communication constraints, and adversarial training ( Pan et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Jung et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025c ; Kontogiannis et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026b ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . Heterogeneity-aware methods, including HARL and its variants ( Zhong et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) and HQP ( Lin and Lee, 2026 ) , further extend coordination to heterogeneous agents.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些基础之上，近期的中心化方法从多个角度进一步改进了在线 MARL，包括价值分解、探索、鲁棒性和可扩展性。 通过更具表现力的分解方法，价值分解和 IGM 原理得到了增强（Huang 等，2026；Xu 等，2026；Qu 等，2026），而通过联合策略对齐和自适应上下文建模，中心化策略优化和探索也得到了改进（Xie 等，2026；Duan 等，2026）。 其他研究则通过正则化、课程学习、通信约束和对抗性训练来探讨探索、鲁棒性和可扩展性问题（Pan 等，2021；Li 等，2023；Li 等，2025b；Jung 等，2025；Chen 等，2025c；Kontogiannis 等，2025；Zhao 等，2025；Zhao 等，2024；Yang 等，2025；Lee 等，2026b；Jiang 等，2026）。 异质性感知方法，包括 HARL 及其变体（Zhong 等，2024；Liu 等，2024）以及 HQP（Lin 和 Lee，2026），进一步将协调机制扩展到了异质智能体。

paragraphs.en: Despite these advances, most online MARL methods use unimodal policies, limiting their ability to represent multimodal coordination strategies. Recent works introduce diffusion policies into online MARL ( Li et al., 2026d ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Lin and Lee, 2026 ) , but iterative denoising incurs substantial sampling and training overhead. Our approach instead employs one-step flow policies, retaining the expressiveness of generative policies while enabling efficient online MARL.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，大多数在线 MARL 方法仍使用单模态策略，这限制了它们表示多模态协调策略的能力。 近期的研究将扩散策略引入在线 MARL（Li et al., 2026d；Zhang et al., 2026c；Lin and Lee, 2026），但迭代去噪会产生巨大的采样和训练开销。 我们的方法则采用一步流策略，既保留了生成策略的表达力，又实现了高效的在线 MARL。

paragraphs.en: Flow-based policies provide an efficient module to achieve iterative denoising by learning velocity fields that enable direct or few-step action generation ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Albergo and Vanden-Eijnden, 2023 ; Lipman et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026e ) . In offline RL, representative approaches such as FQL ( Park et al., 2025 ) , FlowQ ( Alles et al., 2025 ) , QIPO ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , SSCP ( Koirala and Fleming, 2026 ) , GFP ( TIOFACK et al., 2026 ) , FLP ( Xia and Sun, 2026 ) and OFQL ( Nguyen and Yoo, 2026 ) explore flow-based policy learning through one-step generation, energy-guided training, or direct velocity-field learning. Subsequent works further improve flow policies through value-aware generation, behavior regularization, and efficient distillation ( TIOFACK et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Xia and Sun, 2026 ; Duan et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于流的策略提供了一种高效的模块，通过学习速度场来实现迭代去噪，从而能够直接生成或仅用少数步骤生成动作（Lipman 等，2023；Liu 等，2023；Albergo 和 Vanden-Eijnden，2023；Lipman 等，2024；Li 等，2026e）。 在离线强化学习中，代表性的方法如 FQL（Park 等，2025）、FlowQ（Alles 等，2025）、QIPO（Zhang 等，2025a）、SSCP（Koirala 和 Fleming，2026）、GFP（TIOFACK 等，2026）、FLP（Xia 和 Sun，2026）以及 OFQL（Nguyen 和 Yoo，2026），通过单步生成、能量引导训练或直接学习速度场来探索基于流的策略学习。 后续研究进一步通过价值感知生成、行为正则化和高效蒸馏改进了基于流的策略（TIOFACK 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026a；Xia 和 Sun，2026；Duan 等，2025；Li 等，2025a）。

paragraphs.en: These developments naturally extend to multi-agent settings, where expressive generative policies can model diverse joint behaviors and coordination patterns. In offline MARL, early flow-based MARL methods include MAC-Flow ( Lee et al., 2026a ) and OM 2 P ( Li et al., 2026c ) , both of which operate offline and rely on multi-stage training or distillation. To the best of our knowledge, no prior work directly learns flow policies within online MARL, which is the setting addressed by our work.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发展自然地延伸到了多智能体场景，其中具有表现力的生成策略能够模拟多样化的联合行为和协调模式。 在离线多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，早期的基于流的 MARL 方法包括 MAC-Flow（Lee 等人，2026a）和 OM 2 P（Li 等人，2026c），这两种方法均在离线环境中运行，并依赖多阶段训练或蒸馏。 据我们所知，目前还没有先前的工作直接在线学习流策略，而我们的工作正是针对这一场景展开的。

paragraphs.en: Flow policies offer an expressive and efficient parameterization for reinforcement learning ( Nahim et al., 2026 ) , with representative methods including ReinFlow ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , SAC-Flow ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , GS-Flow ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and MVP ( Zhan et al., 2026 ) . Recent studies further enable direct policy-gradient optimization of flow policies, including FPO ( McAllister et al., 2026 ) , OSMFPG ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , LaMPO ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , FlowRL ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) , RFO ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) , MFPO ( Dong et al., 2026 ) , RFM ( Li et al., 2026e ) , and FPMD ( Chen et al., 2025b ) . Despite these advances, existing flow policy optimization methods are predominantly developed for single-agent RL and do not address the challenges of one-step flow optimization in online MARL. Our work extends flow-based policy optimization to this setting by enabling direct one-step flow policy optimization under CTDE.
paragraphs.zh: 流策略为强化学习提供了一种表达力强且高效的参数化方法（Nahim 等人，2026），代表性方法包括 ReinFlow（Zhang 等人，2025b）、SAC-Flow（Zhang 等人，2026b）、GS-Flow（Zhang 等人，2026a）和 MVP（Zhan 等人，2026）。 近期的研究进一步实现了流策略的直接策略梯度优化，包括 FPO（McAllister 等人，2026）、OSMFPG（Wang 等人，2026）、LaMPO（Liu 等人，2026）、FlowRL（Lyu 等人，2026）、RFO（Zhong 等人，2026）、MFPO（Dong 等人，2026）、RFM（Li 等人，2026e）和 FPMD（Chen 等人，2025b）。 尽管取得了这些进展，现有的流策略优化方法主要都是为单智能体强化学习设计的，并未解决在线多智能体强化学习中一步流优化的挑战。 我们的工作通过将直接的一步流策略优化引入 CTDE 框架，将基于流的策略优化扩展到了这一场景。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we provide both the theoretical formulation and the practical implementation of our flow policy. We first show that flow-based policies admit path score surrogate evaluation through the continuous-time change-of-variables formulation. We next derive the corresponding expression and its computation along the flow trajectory. Finally, we detail the flow policy used in our experiments, including the observation-conditioned Transformer architecture for parameterizing the velocity field and the path-wise likelihood surrogate used in practice to provide the log-policy term for policy optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们同时介绍了流策略的理论公式和实际实现。 我们首先证明，通过连续时间变量替换公式，基于流的策略可以接受路径得分的代理评估。 接下来，我们推导出相应的表达式及其沿流轨迹的计算方法。 最后，我们详细说明了实验中使用的流策略，包括用于参数化速度场的观测条件Transformer架构，以及在实际中用于为策略优化提供对数策略项的路径似然代理。

paragraphs.en: Here, SA l \operatorname{SA}_{l} denotes self-attention over the action token, while CA l \operatorname{CA}_{l} uses the decoder representation as the query and the observation context as both key and value. paragraphs.en: OMAF differs from existing Gaussian policies and diffusion policies in both policy parameterization and likelihood estimation. Compared with Gaussian policies, such as HARL ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ) , OMAF parameterizes the policy through a flow velocity field rather than directly specifying a fixed-form Gaussian distribution. Since the marginal likelihood of a flow policy is generally intractable, we use the path score surrogate introduced in Section 5.1 to provide a tractable alternative for entropy-regularized policy optimization. More importantly, even in the one-step setting, the resulting action distribution is fundamentally different from a Gaussian policy. Specifically, the velocity network takes a Gaussian latent variable as input and transforms it through a nonlinear neural network, allowing the induced action distribution to exhibit substantially richer and more complex distributional structures than those obtained by directly predicting a Gaussian mean and standard deviation. Thus, the expressiveness of OMAF arises not from explicitly increasing the number of distributional parameters, but from the nonlinear transformation of Gaussian noise through the learned velocity field.
paragraphs.zh: OMAF 在策略参数化和似然估计方面均不同于现有的高斯策略和扩散策略。 与 HARL（Liu et al., 2024；Zhong et al., 2024）等高斯策略相比，OMAF 通过流速度场来参数化策略，而非直接指定固定形式的高斯分布。 由于流策略的边缘似然通常难以计算，我们使用第 5.1 节中引入的路径得分替代方法，为熵正则化的策略优化提供了一种可计算的替代方案。 更重要的是，即使在单步设置中，由此产生的动作分布也根本不同于高斯策略。 具体而言，速度网络以高斯潜在变量作为输入，并通过非线性神经网络对其进行变换，这使得所诱导的动作分布能够展现出比直接预测高斯均值和标准差所得到的分布结构更为丰富和复杂。 因此，OMAF 的表达力并非源于显式增加分布参数的数量，而是源于通过所学速度场对高斯噪声进行非线性变换。

sents.zh: 与 HARL（Liu et al., 2024；Zhong et al., 2024）等高斯策略相比，OMAF 通过流速度场来参数化策略，而非直接指定固定形式的高斯分布。

sents.en: Since the marginal likelihood of a flow policy is generally intractable, we use the path score surrogate introduced in Section 5.1 to provide a tractable alternative for entropy-regularized policy optimization.
sents.zh: 由于流策略的边缘似然通常难以计算，我们使用第 5.1 节中引入的路径得分替代方法，为熵正则化的策略优化提供了一种可计算的替代方案。

sents.en: More importantly, even in the one-step setting, the resulting action distribution is fundamentally different from a Gaussian policy.
sents.zh: 更重要的是，即使在单步设置中，由此产生的动作分布也根本不同于高斯策略。

sents.en: Specifically, the velocity network takes a Gaussian latent variable as input and transforms it through a nonlinear neural network, allowing the induced action distribution to exhibit substantially richer and more complex distributional structures than those obtained by directly predicting a Gaussian mean and standard deviation.
sents.zh: 具体而言，速度网络以高斯潜在变量作为输入，并通过非线性神经网络对其进行变换，这使得所诱导的动作分布能够展现出比直接预测高斯均值和标准差所得到的分布结构更为丰富和复杂。

sents.en: Thus, the expressiveness of OMAF arises not from explicitly increasing the number of distributional parameters, but from the nonlinear transformation of Gaussian noise through the learned velocity field.
sents.zh: 因此，OMAF 的表达力并非源于显式增加分布参数的数量，而是源于通过所学速度场对高斯噪声进行非线性变换。

paragraphs.en: Compared with diffusion policies, e.g., OMAD ( Li et al., 2026d ) , OMAF differs primarily in the quantity learned to parameterize the generative process. Diffusion policies learn a score function, typically characterized by ∇ a τ ​ log ​ p τ ​ ( a τ , s , τ ) \nabla_{a_{\tau}}\log p_{\tau}(a_{\tau},s,\tau) , whereas OMAF directly learns the velocity field governing the transport of samples along the flow trajectory. Under appropriate transport formulations, the velocity and score can be closely related, and both approaches generally require a trajectory-based surrogate rather than directly evaluating the marginal likelihood of the generated action. Consequently, their generation processes share a similar structure: both transform an initial noisy sample into a terminal action through a learned continuous-time dynamics. The key distinction is that the learned velocity field in OMAF enables effective few-step, and in our setting one-step, action generation, whereas diffusion policies typically rely on iterative denoising across multiple steps. OMAF therefore retains the flexible generative modeling of noise-to-action transport while substantially reducing the computational cost of action generation.
paragraphs.zh: 与扩散策略（例如 OMAD (Li et al., 2026d)）相比，OMAF 的主要区别在于其学习用于参数化生成过程的量不同。 扩散策略学习一个得分函数，通常表示为 ∇ a τ ​ log ​ p τ ​ ( a τ , s , τ ) \nabla_{a_{\tau}}\log p_{\tau}(a_{\tau},s,\tau) ，而 OMAF 则直接学习沿流轨迹控制样本传输的速度场。 在适当的传输公式下，速度场和得分函数可以紧密相关，且这两种方法通常都需要基于轨迹的代理模型，而不是直接评估生成动作的边缘似然。 因此，它们的生成过程具有相似的结构：两者都通过一种学习到的连续时间动态过程，将初始的噪声样本转化为最终的动作。 关键区别在于，OMAF 中学习的速度场能够支持高效的少数步（在我们的设定中为单步）动作生成，而扩散策略通常依赖多步迭代去噪。 因此，OMAF 既保留了从噪声到动作传输的灵活生成建模能力，又显著降低了动作生成的计算成本。

sents.zh: 因此，OMAF 既保留了从噪声到动作传输的灵活生成建模能力，又显著降低了动作生成的计算成本。

paragraphs.en: Existing flow-based reinforcement learning methods, such as SAC-Flow ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) and FlowRL ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) , primarily focus on single-agent decision making, where a flow policy models the action distribution conditioned on the observation of an individual agent. In contrast, OMAF is designed specifically for multi-agent reinforcement learning and adopts a centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) framework to model coordinated behaviors among multiple agents.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基于流的强化学习方法，例如 SAC-Flow（Zhang 等人，2026b）和 FlowRL（Lyu 等人，2026），主要关注单智能体决策，其中流策略根据单个智能体的观测来建模动作分布。 相比之下，OMAF 是专为多智能体强化学习而设计的，它采用集中式训练与去中心化执行（CTDE）框架来建模多个智能体之间的协同行为。

sents.en: Existing flow-based reinforcement learning methods, such as SAC-Flow ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) and FlowRL ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) , primarily focus on single-agent decision making, where a flow policy models the action distribution conditioned on the observation of an individual agent.
sents.zh: 现有的基于流的强化学习方法，例如 SAC-Flow（Zhang 等人，2026b）和 FlowRL（Lyu 等人，2026），主要关注单智能体决策，其中流策略根据单个智能体的观测来建模动作分布。

sents.en: In contrast, OMAF is designed specifically for multi-agent reinforcement learning and adopts a centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) framework to model coordinated behaviors among multiple agents.
sents.zh: 相比之下，OMAF 是专为多智能体强化学习而设计的，它采用集中式训练与去中心化执行（CTDE）框架来建模多个智能体之间的协同行为。

paragraphs.en: This CTDE formulation is particularly important for flow-based policies in multi-agent settings. Although each individual flow policy generates actions locally, the centralized training process provides a global learning signal that allows the policies to account for the effects of other agents’ actions. Consequently, OMAF can learn coordinated behaviors while preserving decentralized execution and avoiding the need for global information at deployment time.
paragraphs.zh: 这种 CTDE 形式在多人智能体环境中，对于基于流的策略尤为重要。 尽管每个独立的流策略都在本地生成动作，但集中式训练过程提供了一个全局学习信号，使这些策略能够考虑其他智能体动作所带来的影响。 因此，OMAF 能够在保持去中心化执行的同时学习协调一致的行为，并且无需在部署阶段使用全局信息。

sents.en: This CTDE formulation is particularly important for flow-based policies in multi-agent settings.
sents.zh: 这种 CTDE 形式在多人智能体环境中，对于基于流的策略尤为重要。

sents.en: Although each individual flow policy generates actions locally, the centralized training process provides a global learning signal that allows the policies to account for the effects of other agents’ actions.
sents.zh: 尽管每个独立的流策略都在本地生成动作，但集中式训练过程提供了一个全局学习信号，使这些策略能够考虑其他智能体动作所带来的影响。

sents.en: Consequently, OMAF can learn coordinated behaviors while preserving decentralized execution and avoiding the need for global information at deployment time.
sents.zh: 因此，OMAF 能够在保持去中心化执行的同时学习协调一致的行为，并且无需在部署阶段使用全局信息。

paragraphs.en: Another key distinction is that OMAF is designed around one-step flow-based action generation. Rather than directly extending a single-agent flow policy to multiple agents, OMAF jointly optimizes the decentralized flow policies with the centralized critic under the multi-agent CTDE framework. This design enables expressive continuous action modeling while substantially reducing the sampling overhead associated with iterative generative policies. These differences make OMAF particularly suited to online multi-agent coordination, where both expressive action distributions and efficient interaction with the environment are essential.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个关键区别在于，OMAF 是围绕单步流式动作生成设计的。 OMAF 并非直接将单智能体流策略扩展到多智能体，而是在多智能体 CTDE 框架下，联合优化去中心化的流策略与集中式评论家。 这种设计既支持富有表现力的连续动作建模，又能显著降低迭代生成策略相关的采样开销。 这些差异使得 OMAF 特别适合在线多智能体协调任务，因为这类任务既需要富有表现力的动作分布，也需要与环境进行高效交互。

paragraphs.en: We conduct experiments on two widely used multi-agent continuous-control benchmarks, Multi-Agent Particle Environments (MPE) ( Lowe et al., 2017 ) 1 1 1 https://pettingzoo.farama.org/environments/mpe/ and Multi-Agent MuJoCo (MAMuJoCo) ( Peng et al., 2021 ) 2 2 2 https://robotics.farama.org/envs/MaMuJoCo/ . In MPE, we consider one representative task, Cooperative Navigation . Cooperative Navigation requires multiple agents to jointly cover a set of landmarks while avoiding collisions (Figure 6(a) ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个广泛使用的多智能体连续控制基准数据集上进行了实验，即多智能体粒子环境（Multi-Agent Particle Environments, MPE）（Lowe 等人，2017）1 1 1 https://pettingzoo.farama.org/environments/mpe/ 和多智能体 MuJoCo（Multi-Agent MuJoCo, MAMuJoCo）（Peng 等人，2021）2 2 2 https://robotics.farama.org/envs/MaMuJoCo/。 在 MPE 中，我们考虑了一个代表性任务：协同导航。 协同导航要求多个智能体共同覆盖一组地标，同时避免碰撞（图 6(a)）。

paragraphs.en: For MAMuJoCo, we consider these locomotion environments: Ant (Figure 6(b) ), HalfCheetah (Figure 6(c) ), CoupledHalfCheetah (Figure 6(d) ), Walker2d (Figure 6(e) ), and Swimmer (Figure 6(g) ). MAMuJoCo converts conventional single-agent MuJoCo control tasks into multi-agent settings by assigning different subsets of the robot’s actuators to different agents. The resulting agents jointly control the same physical system, making coordinated continuous control essential for successful locomotion. The configurations used in our experiments are summarized below.

paragraphs.en: Compared with the conventional single-agent MuJoCo formulation, MAMuJoCo introduces decentralized control by distributing the robot’s actuators across multiple agents. Although the agents interact through a shared physical system, each agent controls only a subset of the action dimensions. As a result, the effect of an individual action depends on the states and actions of the other agents, creating strong physical coupling and coordination requirements. These characteristics make MAMuJoCo a useful benchmark for evaluating multi-agent policy learning in high-dimensional continuous control.
paragraphs.zh: 与传统的单智能体 MuJoCo 设定相比，MAMuJoCo 通过将机器人的执行器分配给多个智能体，引入了去中心化的控制方式。 尽管这些智能体通过共享的物理系统相互作用，但每个智能体仅控制动作维度的一个子集。 因此，单个动作的效果取决于其他智能体的状态和动作，从而产生了强烈的物理耦合与协调需求。 这些特性使 MAMuJoCo 成为评估高维连续控制中多智能体策略学习的有效基准。

sents.zh: 与传统的单智能体 MuJoCo 设定相比，MAMuJoCo 通过将机器人的执行器分配给多个智能体，引入了去中心化的控制方式。

sents.en: Although the agents interact through a shared physical system, each agent controls only a subset of the action dimensions.
sents.zh: 尽管这些智能体通过共享的物理系统相互作用，但每个智能体仅控制动作维度的一个子集。

sents.en: As a result, the effect of an individual action depends on the states and actions of the other agents, creating strong physical coupling and coordination requirements.
sents.zh: 因此，单个动作的效果取决于其他智能体的状态和动作，从而产生了强烈的物理耦合与协调需求。

sents.en: These characteristics make MAMuJoCo a useful benchmark for evaluating multi-agent policy learning in high-dimensional continuous control.
sents.zh: 这些特性使 MAMuJoCo 成为评估高维连续控制中多智能体策略学习的有效基准。

paragraphs.en: For the critic, we employ a centralized Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) to estimate a scalar Q Q -value from the joint state and joint action. The state-action input is concatenated and normalized using Batch Normalization before being fed into the network. The critic consists of two hidden layers with 1024 1024 units per layer and ReLU activations, followed by a single scalar output. We maintain two critics to reduce estimation bias and improve the stability of value learning.
paragraphs.zh: 对于评判者，我们采用一个集中式的多层感知器（MLP），从联合状态和联合动作中估计一个标量 Q 值。 在输入网络之前，状态-动作输入会被拼接并通过批归一化进行标准化。 该评判者包含两个隐藏层，每层有 1024 个单元并使用 ReLU 激活函数，最后接一个标量输出。 我们维护两个评判者，以减少估计偏差并提升价值学习的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: For the actor, we employ the flow-based policy described in Appendix C . The flow velocity is parameterized by an observation-conditioned Transformer, which takes the current latent action, flow time, and local observation as inputs. We use a one-step flow transformation ( H = 1 H=1 ), while the Transformer architecture and the corresponding policy optimization details are provided in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 对于智能体，我们采用了附录 C 中描述的基于流的策略。 流速度由一个以观测值为条件的 Transformer 参数化，该 Transformer 将当前的潜在动作、流时间和局部观测值作为输入。 我们使用了一步流变换（H = 1 H=1），而 Transformer 架构和相应的策略优化细节则见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: To stabilize critic training, we maintain a target policy network for generating next-step actions. The target policy is updated according to an exponential moving average with coefficient ρ \rho . In our experiments, ρ = 0 \rho=0 , corresponding to a hard-update scheme in which the target policy is updated directly rather than through a soft moving average. The critic uses a discount factor of γ = 0.99 \gamma=0.99 for computing discounted target values.
paragraphs.zh: 为了稳定评论者训练，我们维护一个目标策略网络，用于生成下一步动作。 目标策略根据指数移动平均法进行更新，其系数为 ρ \rho 。 在我们的实验中，ρ = 0 \rho=0 ，这对应于硬更新方案，即直接更新目标策略，而不是通过软移动平均法进行更新。 评论者在计算折扣目标值时，使用的折扣因子为 γ = 0.99 \gamma=0.99 。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we perform ablation studies to investigate the impact of three key design choices in OMAF: the denoising steps of the flow policy, the Transformer depth of the velocity network, and the softmax temperature for Q-value estimation. We systematically vary these components to understand their individual effects on policy performance and training efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们进行了消融研究，以探究 OMAF 中三个关键设计选择的影响：流策略的去噪步骤、速度网络的 Transformer 深度以及 Q 值估计的 softmax 温度。 我们通过系统地调整这些组件，来理解它们对策略性能和训练效率的各自影响。

sents.en: In this section, we perform ablation studies to investigate the impact of three key design choices in OMAF: the denoising steps of the flow policy, the Transformer depth of the velocity network, and the softmax temperature for Q-value estimation.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们进行了消融研究，以探究 OMAF 中三个关键设计选择的影响：流策略的去噪步骤、速度网络的 Transformer 深度以及 Q 值估计的 softmax 温度。

sents.en: We systematically vary these components to understand their individual effects on policy performance and training efficiency.
sents.zh: 我们通过系统地调整这些组件，来理解它们对策略性能和训练效率的各自影响。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7(a) compares OMAF with different numbers of denoising steps on the Ant2x4 environment over 1M training steps. All variants are able to learn effective policies and achieve more than 6,500 episodic returns, demonstrating the robustness of the proposed flow policy across different denoising configurations. Notably, the one-step variant achieves the best performance, while requiring only a single function evaluation to generate an action. This result highlights the efficiency of one-step denoising for online policy optimization. In contrast, increasing the number of denoising steps does not lead to consistent performance improvements. A potential explanation is that our policy is updated through Q-value guidance, where the policy gradient is backpropagated through the generated action. With multiple denoising steps, the action depends on a longer sequence of flow transformations, which may introduce additional optimization effects and make the Q-guided policy update less direct. Therefore, one-step flow generation provides a particularly favorable trade-off between expressive policy modeling and efficient gradient-based policy optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7(a) 比较了 OMAF 在 Ant2x4 环境中使用不同数量去噪步骤，经过 100 万次训练步后的表现。 所有变体都能学会有效的策略，并实现超过 6,500 的每集回报，这表明所提出的流策略在不同去噪配置下具有稳健性。 值得注意的是，单步变体实现了最佳性能，而生成一个动作仅需一次函数评估。 这一结果凸显了单步去噪在在线策略优化中的高效性。 相比之下，增加去噪步骤的数量并未带来持续的性能提升。 一种可能的解释是，我们的策略通过 Q 值引导进行更新，其中策略梯度通过生成的动作反向传播。 当使用多个去噪步骤时，动作会依赖于更长的流变换序列，这可能会引入额外的优化效应，并使基于 Q 值的策略更新变得不那么直接。 因此，单步流生成在表达力强的策略建模与高效的基于梯度的策略优化之间实现了尤为理想的权衡。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate how network architecture depth influences policy learning, we compare OMAF across different numbers of Transformer layers ( 1 1 , 2 2 , and 3 3 ). As shown in the training curves, a shallower network (depth = 1) yields a simpler policy, but its limited representation capacity slows down early learning and bounds the overall return. Increasing the depth enhances policy expressiveness, with depth = 3 achieving faster convergence and superior final performance. However, deeper architectures also introduce higher training difficulty and potential optimization instability, as reflected in the variance observed with intermediate settings. These results emphasize the need to strike a balance between policy expressiveness and optimization stability when configuring the network depth.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估网络架构深度如何影响策略学习，我们比较了不同 Transformer 层数（1、2 和 3）下的 OMAF。 如训练曲线所示，较浅的网络（深度 = 1）会产生更简单的策略，但其有限的表示能力会减缓早期学习过程并限制整体回报。 增加深度可提升策略的表达能力，其中深度 = 3 实现了更快的收敛和更优的最终性能。 然而，更深的架构也会带来更高的训练难度和潜在的优化不稳定性，这一点在中间设置中观察到的方差中得到了体现。 这些结果强调了在配置网络深度时，需要在策略表达能力与优化稳定性之间取得平衡的必要性。

The experimental results are presented in the bar plot in Fig. 7(c) . The results indicate that the temperature needs to be appropriately selected to achieve effective softmax-based target value correction. paragraphs.en: To examine the exploration benefits of our expressive flow policies, we analyze the state distributions collected in the replay buffers after the first 250K training steps on Ant 2 × 4 2\times 4 ( Li et al., 2026d ) . We discretize the 2D state space (dimensions 23 and 13) over [ − 4 , 8.5 ] × [ − 17.5 , 17.5 ] [-4,8.5]\times[-17.5,17.5] with a grid interval of 0.5 0.5 , yielding 1750 bins. OMAF visits 1,162 distinct bins, achieving the broadest state-space coverage, compared with 958 for OMAD, 942 for HATD3, 861 for MAFlowRL, 826 for HASAC, and 819 for MAMFPO. The uniquely explored regions further show that OMAF’s expressive entropy-regularized flow policy enables broader exploration and helps avoid getting trapped in local optima.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验我们具有表现力的流策略在探索方面的优势，我们分析了在 Ant 2 × 4 2\times 4（Li et al., 2026d）上完成最初 250K 训练步后，重播缓冲区中收集到的状态分布。 我们将二维状态空间（维度为 23 和 13）在区间 [−4, 8.5] × [−17.5, 17.5] 内以 0.5 的网格间隔进行离散化，从而得到 1750 个分箱。 OMAF 访问了 1,162 个不同的分箱，实现了最广泛的状态空间覆盖；相比之下，OMAD 为 958，HATD3 为 942，MAFlowRL 为 861，HASAC 为 826，MAMFPO 为 819。 这些独特探索的区域进一步表明，OMA F 具有表现力的熵正则化流策略能够支持更广泛的探索，并有助于避免陷入局部最优解。

paragraphs.en: As the number of agents grows, multi-agent policy learning becomes increasingly challenging due to the growing dimensionality of joint observations and actions, as well as the stronger coordination dependencies among agents. These challenges are particularly pronounced for expressive generative policies, where action generation may introduce additional computational overhead. In conventional diffusion-based policies, multiple denoising iterations can further increase the cost of generating joint actions, making efficient scaling an important consideration for large-agent systems. Moreover, directly increasing the number of agents in physics-based environments such as MAMuJoCo changes the underlying system dynamics, making controlled scalability studies difficult. We therefore evaluate OMAF on Cooperative Navigation, where the number of agents can be varied while preserving the same underlying task structure.
paragraphs.zh: 随着智能体数量的增加，多智能体策略学习变得日益困难，因为联合观测和行动维度的增长，以及智能体之间更强的协调依赖关系。 对于表达能力强的生成式策略而言，这些挑战尤为显著，因为行动生成可能会带来额外的计算开销。 在传统的基于扩散的策略中，多次去噪迭代会进一步增加生成联合行动的成本，因此高效扩展成为大规模智能体系统的重要考量因素。 此外，在 MAMuJoCo 这类基于物理的环境中直接增加智能体数量会改变底层系统动态，使得受控的可扩展性研究变得困难。 因此，我们在“协作导航”任务上评估 OMAF，该任务允许在保持相同底层任务结构的同时调整智能体数量。

sents.en: As the number of agents grows, multi-agent policy learning becomes increasingly challenging due to the growing dimensionality of joint observations and actions, as well as the stronger coordination dependencies among agents.
sents.zh: 随着智能体数量的增加，多智能体策略学习变得日益困难，因为联合观测和行动维度的增长，以及智能体之间更强的协调依赖关系。

sents.en: These challenges are particularly pronounced for expressive generative policies, where action generation may introduce additional computational overhead.
sents.zh: 对于表达能力强的生成式策略而言，这些挑战尤为显著，因为行动生成可能会带来额外的计算开销。

sents.en: In conventional diffusion-based policies, multiple denoising iterations can further increase the cost of generating joint actions, making efficient scaling an important consideration for large-agent systems.
sents.zh: 在传统的基于扩散的策略中，多次去噪迭代会进一步增加生成联合行动的成本，因此高效扩展成为大规模智能体系统的重要考量因素。

sents.en: Moreover, directly increasing the number of agents in physics-based environments such as MAMuJoCo changes the underlying system dynamics, making controlled scalability studies difficult.
sents.zh: 此外，在 MAMuJoCo 这类基于物理的环境中直接增加智能体数量会改变底层系统动态，使得受控的可扩展性研究变得困难。

sents.en: We therefore evaluate OMAF on Cooperative Navigation, where the number of agents can be varied while preserving the same underlying task structure.
sents.zh: 因此，我们在“协作导航”任务上评估 OMAF，该任务允许在保持相同底层任务结构的同时调整智能体数量。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports the performance with 10 agents and 20 agents. OMAF outperforms the considered baselines, including conventional centralized-critic methods and existing flow- or diffusion-based approaches. The relatively small variance also indicates stable coordination among a larger number of agents. More importantly, OMAF generates actions using a single flow step, avoiding the repeated denoising procedure required by multi-step generative policies. This substantially reduces the computation associated with joint action generation as the number of agents increases. Overall, the results demonstrate that OMAF can maintain effective multi-agent coordination in a substantially larger system while retaining an efficient action-generation mechanism, providing a practical basis for scaling flow-based MARL to larger agent populations.

paragraphs.en: For a fair and consistent comparison, we evaluate all algorithms using three independent random seeds, uniformly fixed to 0, 42, and 3407 across all methods. All other experimental settings are kept consistent with the respective algorithm implementations to ensure that the comparison is not affected by differences in random initialization. At each evaluation point, we roll out the current policy for 10 episodes and use the average episodic return as the evaluation performance; we then report the mean and standard deviation across the three random seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进行公平且一致的比较，我们使用三个独立的随机种子对所有算法进行评估，并在所有方法中统一固定为 0、42 和 3407。 所有其他实验设置均与相应算法的实现保持一致，以确保比较结果不受随机初始化差异的影响。 在每个评估点，我们会运行当前策略 10 个回合，并使用平均回合回报作为评估性能；然后报告三个随机种子下的均值和标准差。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate performance under a limited interaction budget, we compare OMAF with all baseline methods within 2M training steps. This evaluation protocol emphasizes the early-stage learning performance of each method and allows us to assess how effectively the algorithms utilize limited environment interactions. Under this setting, OMAF achieves strong performance within substantially fewer training steps, demonstrating its advantage in the early stages of online learning.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估在有限交互预算下的性能，我们在 200 万次训练步内将 OMAF 与所有基线方法进行了比较。 这种评估方案强调了每种方法在早期阶段的學習表现，并使我们能够评估算法如何有效利用有限的环境交互。 在此设置下，OMAF 在显著较少的训练步内实现了强劲的性能，证明了其在在线学习早期阶段的优势。

paragraphs.en: We further examine the learning curves over longer training horizons. While several baseline methods continue to improve with additional environment interactions, OMAF reaches its converged performance earlier. This indicates that the baselines can benefit from prolonged training, but require more interaction steps to realize their full performance. In contrast, OMAF is built upon an efficient generative policy that enables effective policy learning with fewer environment interactions, highlighting its interaction efficiency for online multi-agent reinforcement learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步考察了更长训练周期内的学习曲线。 尽管多种基线方法随着与环境交互次数的增加而持续改进，但 OMAF 更早地达到了其收敛性能。 这表明基线方法可以从延长训练中受益，但需要更多的交互步骤才能实现其完整性能。 相比之下，OMAF 构建于一种高效的生成策略之上，这种策略能够以更少的环境交互实现有效的策略学习，凸显了其在在线多智能体强化学习中的交互效率。

paragraphs.en: The Sample Efficiency dimension measures the relative number of environment interactions required to reach a specified target return. For each environment, we define a target return threshold and record the number of training steps at which the mean learning curve across the three random seeds reaches this threshold for the first time. Methods that do not reach the target within the evaluation horizon are assigned a value of 1.0. The target return thresholds are 3510.4 for Ant 2x4, 2500 for Ant 4x2, 3620.8 for Ant 2x4d, 3370.7 for Walker2d 2x3, 5000 for HalfCheetah 2x3, 10000 for HalfCheetah 6x1, 1402.3 for Coupled HalfCheetah, 2800 for Hopper 3x1, 47.0 for Swimmer 2x1, and -120 for Cooperative Navigation 5.

paragraphs.en: For each environment, we compute the ratio based on the number of training steps required to reach the corresponding threshold and then average the ratios across the ten environments. paragraphs.en: The Exploration dimension measures the coverage of the visited state space during the early stage of training. Specifically, we collect the states encountered by each algorithm during the first 250K training steps on the Ant 2 × \times 4 environment and construct a two-dimensional state occupancy map using the 15th and 25th state dimensions. We discretize the state space into a fixed grid with a bin width of 0.5, where the first dimension ranges from − 17.5 -17.5 to 17.5 17.5 with 70 bins and the second dimension ranges from − 4 -4 to 8.5 8.5 with 25 bins, resulting in 1,750 bins in total. Samples falling outside these ranges are discarded rather than assigned to boundary bins. A bin is considered visited if it contains at least one collected state. The resulting numbers of occupied bins are 942 for HATD3, 826 for HASAC, 819 for MAMFPO, 861 for MAFlowRL, 958 for OMAD, and 1,162 for OMAF.
paragraphs.zh: 探索维度衡量训练初期阶段所访问状态空间的覆盖范围。 具体而言，我们在 Ant 2 × \times 4 环境中收集各算法在前 250K 个训练步骤中遇到的状态，并使用第 15 维和第 25 维状态构建二维状态占用图。 我们将状态空间离散化为一个固定网格，每个分箱宽度为 0.5，其中第一维从 − 17.5 -17.5 到 17.5 17.5，共 70 个分箱；第二维从 − 4 -4 到 8.5 8.5，共 25 个分箱，总计 1,750 个分箱。 超出这些范围的数据样本将被丢弃，而非分配至边界分箱。 若某个分箱包含至少一个已收集的状态，则被视为已被访问。 最终各算法的已占用分箱数量分别为：HATD3 为 942，HASAC 为 826，MAMFPO 为 819，MAFlowRL 为 861，OMAD 为 958，以及 OMAF 为 1,162。

paragraphs.en: The Scalability dimension measures the performance of each algorithm under different numbers of agents. We use the Cooperative Navigation environment with N = 10 N=10 and N = 20 N=20 agents and compute the metric from the mean episodic returns at each scale. The reported standard deviations are not used in the calculation. For consistency with the naming of other baselines, IMFPO and IFlowRL are denoted as MAMFPO and MAFlowRL, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 可扩展性维度衡量了每种算法在不同数量的智能体下的性能。 我们使用智能体数量分别为 N = 10 和 N = 20 的合作导航环境，并在每个规模下根据平均回合回报计算该指标。 报告的标准差未用于计算中。 为与其他基线方法命名保持一致，IMFPO 和 IFlowRL 分别表示为 MAMFPO 和 MAFlowRL。

paragraphs.en: For each agent scale independently, we apply min-max normalization to the mean returns: S N , m = R N , m − R N , min R N , max − R N , min × 100 , S_{N,m}=\frac{R_{N,m}-R_{N,\min}}{R_{N,\max}-R_{N,\min}}\times 100, where R N , m R_{N,m} is the mean return of algorithm m m at agent scale N N . Since higher returns indicate better performance, a larger normalized score corresponds to better performance at the given scale. At N = 10 N=10 , the best and worst mean returns are − 429.4 -429.4 (OMAF) and − 478.4 -478.4 (MAMFPO), respectively. At N = 20 N=20 , they are − 1433.4 -1433.4 (OMAF) and − 1801.4 -1801.4 (OMAD), respectively.

OMAD uses 600 NVIDIA V100 GPUs, 20 NVIDIA H20 GPUs, and 60 NVIDIA A100 GPUs. We estimate the computational cost as the aggregate FP32 peak throughput of the GPUs used by each algorithm multiplied by its wall-clock training time.

paragraphs.en: Importantly, OMAF achieves its strong performance with dramatically lower computational resource requirements than the diffusion-based OMAD, using only 12 GPUs compared with 680 GPUs in the reported training setup. This substantial reduction in GPU consumption highlights the exceptional training efficiency of OMAF, demonstrating that competitive or stronger policy performance can be achieved with only a small fraction of the computational resources required by iterative diffusion-based policy learning.
paragraphs.zh: 重要的是，OMAF 以远低于基于扩散模型的 OMAD 的计算资源需求实现了其强大的性能：报告中的训练设置使用了 680 块 GPU，而 OMAF 仅需要 12 块。 GPU 消耗量的这种显著降低凸显了 OMAF 卓越的训练效率，表明只需使用迭代式基于扩散的政策学习所需计算资源的极小一部分，就能实现具有竞争力的政策性能，甚至更优的性能。

paragraphs.en: Our work focuses on efficient online multi-agent coordination in continuous control settings. Accordingly, we evaluate the proposed framework on representative continuous-control benchmarks, including MPE and MAMuJoCo, where agents interact through continuous action spaces and exhibit challenging coordination dynamics arising from physical coupling. We do not consider discrete-action benchmarks such as SMAC in this work, as the proposed flow-based policy is specifically designed to model continuous action distributions. Extending the framework to discrete action spaces, for example through discrete flow formulations or categorical action representations, would require additional methodological development and is left for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作专注于在连续控制场景下实现高效的在线多智能体协同。 因此，我们在具有代表性的连续控制基准数据集上对提出的框架进行了评估，包括 MPE 和 MAMuJoCo。在这些任务中，智能体通过连续动作空间进行交互，并因物理耦合而表现出复杂的协同动态。 本研究不考虑 SMAC 等离散动作基准，因为所提出的基于流的策略是专门用于建模连续动作分布的。 要将该框架扩展到离散动作空间（例如，通过离散流公式或分类动作表示），则需要进一步的方法论开发，这部分工作留待未来完成。

paragraphs.en: To complement the quantitative evaluation, we visualize the behaviors learned by OMAF across four representative MAMuJoCo tasks in Figure 9 . For each task, we show the agent configurations at timesteps t ∈ 1,100,250,500 t\in{1,100,250,500} together with their instantaneous velocities. Across different environments, the agents progressively develop consistent locomotion patterns and maintain stable motion throughout the trajectories. In the CoupledHalfCheetah, Walker2d 2 × 3 2\times 3 , and Ant 2 × 4 2\times 4 tasks, the agents exhibit coordinated movements despite their interactions being governed by the underlying coupled dynamics, while the Swimmer 2 × 1 2\times 1 agents maintain a coherent forward-moving pattern. These visualizations provide qualitative evidence that OMAF can learn stable and coordinated locomotion behaviors across diverse multi-agent continuous-control settings.

paragraphs.en: To further examine the coordination efficiency of OMAF under a limited training budget, we visualize the evaluation trajectories of all six algorithms on the Coupled HalfCheetah environment after a fixed number of training steps.
